Name: Paper
Description: Canvas for writing, drawing, and inscribing. 10 sheets.

Name: Ink
Description: Used for writing, drawing, and inscribing. Enough for 20 sheets of paper.

Name: Pen
Description: Tool for writing, drawing, and inscribing.

Name: Cloth
Description: Used to make clothing and cloth armor.

Name: Wire
Description: Used with cloth and leather to make clothes and armor.

Name: Meat
Description: Used with a Cooking Kit to make enough food to feed an adventurer one day. Presalted to last 3 days.

Name: Wood
Description: Used for fletching, furnishing, and construction.

Name: Herbs
Description: Used to make foods, beverages, and cloth.

Name: Hide
Description: Used to make crude armor, or with a tanning kit to make leather.

Name: Spices
Description: Used with herbs/meat to make gourmet foods.

Name: Minerals
Description: Used with herbs/meat to make gourmet foods.

Name: Leather
Description: Used to make light armor.

Name: Steel
Description: Used to forge metal items, weapons, and/or armor.

Name: Alchemy Kit
Description: Used with herbs to create potions and beverages. Reusable.

Name: Pulping Kit
Description: Used with 1 wood to make 10 paper, or 100 paper to make a tome. Reusable.

Name: Tanning Kit
Description: Used with hide and wire to make leather. Reusable.

Name: Processing Kit
Description: Used with herbs to create cloth. Resuable.

Name: Cooking Kit
Description: Used with fire, meat and/or herbs to cook food. Reusable.

Name: Chef Kit
Description: Used with meat/herbs with spices/minerals to cook gourmet food. Takes up weight. Reusable.

Name: Silver
Description: Used to forge metal items, weapons, and/or armor.

Name: Duranium
Description: Used to reinforce armor and spacefaring vehicles.

Name: Adamantium
Description: Used to make the strongest and heaviest weapons and armor. AKA Truesteel

Name: Mithril
Description: Used to make lighter and durable weapons and armor.

Name: Protosteel
Description: Used to make virtually unbreakable weapons and armor.

Name: Vibranium
Description: Used to make mighty and mystical weapons and armor.

Name: Chipped Gem
Description: Used for jewellry and socketing in level 1 enchantments.

Name: Flawed Gem
Description: Used for jewellry and socketing in level 2 enchantments.

Name: Gem
Description: Used for jewellry and socketing in level 3 enchantments.

Name: Flawless Gem
Description: Used for jewellry and socketing in level 4 enchantments.

Name: Brilliant Gem
Description: Used for jewellry and socketing in level 5 enchantments.

Name: Perfect Gem
Description: Used for jewellry and socketing in level 6 enchantments.
